title: Inflight Preserver + Atomic Shed Adapter with Regional Fallback Stub
author: Priya Raman
ci_status: pass (unit/linux, integration/graceful-degrade, telemetry); lint required a fix and passed on rerun
release_notes: Fix: Preserve inflight requests during tenant-driven load-shedding to avoid KV cache loss; Add adapter to make shed decisions atomic per-tenant; Add regional fallback stub for safe rejoin path; Telemetry: new metrics for preserved_inflight_count and preserved_replay_latency.
description: Motivation: during aggressive regional or tenant load-shedding we observed a class of failures where in-flight requests were dropped mid-evacuation, their KV caches drained, and subsequent retries hit higher cost regenerations. This causes visible latency spikes and SLO churn for heavy tenants. This PR introduces a lightweight 'Inflight Preserver' and an 'Atomic Shed Adapter' that together make shedding decisions atomic at the request envelope level and preserve inflight state for safe replay. Additionally, a tiny regional-fallback stub is added to the routing layer to accept preserved inflight leases and replay them to a compatible fallback model variant when local capacity is constrained. Key changes: 1) inflight preserver: leases in-memory with compact metadata and soft TTL to keep KV context until replay or expiry; preserved requests are rate-limited and prioritized for replay; 2) atomic shed adapter: centralizes tenant-level shed decisions so that either the whole request is shed or fully preserved, preventing partial drains; 3) regional fallback stub: non-blocking route that accepts preserved leases and forwards to fallback model variants with KV-preserve headers; 4) telemetry: added preserved_inflight_count, preserved_replay_success, preserved_replay_latency and shed_decision_latency metrics; 5) tests and migration: unit and integration tests for eviction->preserve->replay path, plus a compatibility flag to toggle preserving behavior per release. Rollout plan: feature gated by 'enable_inflight_preserve' runtime flag; gradual canary to 10% of regions then 50% after 24h of stability. Rollback plan: flip runtime flag to false; preserved leases expire naturally and no replay will be attempted. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-4621; [x] unit tests for preserver and adapter; [x] integration run in staging with synthetic surge; [x] telemetry dashboards added (temporary); [x] canary rollout plan documented. Impact: reduces tail-regeneration events during regional-shed scenarios and improves SLO stability for high-throughput tenants. Non-breaking when disabled.
